guard: bare status checks only the selected registration unless --all, reports a part it cannot read, a persona catalog, the current-mesh pointer and a registry record included, as partial with a named warning, prints its sections in the agreed order with the hints last, and refuses --components with --all
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/status-report.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.cell: the other registration is not checked

mutations.replace: const meshes = await readMeshes(selected, false, gaps);
